tool_config.name: sales_flow_step
tool_config.description: Reports the prospect's latest stage-relevant reply to the sales flow controller, which decides the next stage. Call it before answering whenever the reply changes the situation.

intent.description: The single intent that best matches the prospect's latest reply.

objection_ids.description: For objection_raised / question_asked: comma-separated registry ids, e.g. "asks_for_pricing,already_uses_crm". Valid ids: already_has_sales_team, already_uses_crm, prefers_real_people, concerned_about_ai_voice, asks_for_pricing, how_does_it_know_inventory, fits_existing_workflow, measuring_performance, privacy_concern, requests_case_study, send_information, needs_management_approval, requests_human.

escalate.description: True only if the concern needs the human team (pricing, legal, technical specifics) per the registry.

field.description: For discovery_answer: which fact the prospect just gave.

value.description: For discovery_answer: the fact in a few words, as stated. Empty if they did not really answer.

early_presentation.description: For discovery_complete: true only if the prospect explicitly asked what the product is.

next_step.description: For next_step_agreed: the step the prospect explicitly agreed to.

callback_time.description: For follow_up_captured: day/time window in the prospect's words.
